author: 578RobertD578

title: Private Tour to Montserrat with an outstanding tour guide!
text: Our pre-arrival communication with Barcelona Day Tours was outstanding.  They made suggestions for us for our tours and made the arrangements for tickets that needed to be purchased ahead.  Our visit to Montserrat was wonderful and I would recommend any visitor to go.  We added an extra hour to our tour in order to stay longer to see the Boys Choir perform at 1:00 which was well worth it.  The museum/art gallery there was interesting as well.  Our guide, Christian, was outstanding!  We are seniors, one of which has limited mobility.  There is a lot of walking up hill at Montserrat.  Christian
author: mah813

title: Montserrat and Cava Winery tour was a spectacular small van tour and experience!
text: Montserrat and Cava Winery tour. We did the van for 12 people, with a pickup near our hotel. The morning pickup at 8:30 meant we arrived at Montserrat in time to see the clouds rolling away below us, which was a surreal experience! The guide gave us a great tour coming and going, and clear explanation of options and timing for our free time. The landscape alone is unique and amazing. The Cava Winery after was a really spectacular addition! A historic building, delicious wines to try, outdoor or tasting rooms seating, and local artworks around the premises. Very unique and lovely! title: Great way to get from airport to hotel
text: Communication was top notch, both before I paid and after I paid for the tour, Christopher was timely to pick up from the airport. He was knowledgeable about the area and very personable. He was flexible with the tour to allow us time in the areas we chose to see more of.  We even enjoyed lunch at a little cafe that the locals eat at (off the beaten path), which is something we truly enjoy! It was nice to enjoy such a nice but relaxed tour after arriving early to Barcelona and knowing our hotel would not be available until 3pm. Christopher dropped us off right at the door of our hotel.
author: 556kathlenej

title: great private tour of Montserrat
text:
The day of our tour was the national Catalan holiday so we were picked up early (0700). This ended up being perfect as we arrived at the cathedral before it got busy. So our guide was able to do some fast talking with security and we got to actually see the black Madonna. Also being early meant there were no queues for the fernicula ip the mountain or the gondola down.

Our guide, Christian, was knowledgeable of the local area and his English was good. He also took some great photos of.

I recommend this company as we had a few scheduling issues due to my mistakes and they worked through these
